episodes.title: The New Princess at School
episodes.subtitle: A Royal Academy Story about Kindness

beats.title: Arrival at the Courtyard
beats.story: It is a sunny morning at the Royal Academy! A new student, Princess Maya, stands near the courtyard fountain holding her satchel. She looks a little nervous.

choices.label: Wave and say hello!
choices.reactionText: Princess Maya smiles brightly! "Thank you for saying hi! I was hoping to make a friend today."

choices.label: Ignore her and walk past
choices.reactionText: Princess Maya looks down at her shoes and hugs her satchel a little tighter.

beats.title: The Banquet Table
beats.story: At lunchtime, the Grand Banquet Hall is filled with laughter and starberry tarts. Princess Maya carries her tray, looking for an open seat.

choices.label: Invite her to sit next to you
choices.reactionText: "Really? Thank you!" Princess Maya sits down happily and shares a starberry tart.

choices.label: Say the seat is saved
choices.reactionText: Princess Maya nods quietly and walks to a quiet corner table all by herself.

beats.title: Potion Lab Partners
beats.story: In afternoon Potion Lab, Professor Sparkle asks everyone to pick a partner to brew a shimmering rainbow elixir. Princess Maya doesn't have a partner yet.

choices.label: Ask her to be your partner
choices.reactionText: Together you stir the cauldron, and a burst of golden sparkles fills the air! "We make a great team!" Maya cheers.

choices.label: Leave her out and pair with someone else
choices.reactionText: Princess Maya has to work alone at the back table, watching everyone else laugh together.

beats.title: The Dropped Spellbook
beats.story: After class in the hallway, Princess Maya trips over her hem and her heavy spellbook tumbles open across the floor.

choices.label: Help her pick up the spellbook
choices.reactionText: You kneel down and gather the pages together. "You're so kind," Princess Maya says with a warm smile.

choices.label: Laugh and walk away
choices.reactionText: Princess Maya's cheeks turn pink as she hurries to gather her pages alone.

welcoming.title: A New Royal Friendship!
welcoming.story: At the end of the day, Princess Maya beams with joy. Because you welcomed her, invited her to lunch, partnered with her, and helped her out, she feels right at home at the Royal Academy. Kindness makes every kingdom brighter!

exclusionary.title: A Quiet Reflection
exclusionary.story: As the school bell rings, Princess Maya walks home quietly. Being new at school can feel lonely when others leave us out. Tomorrow is a brand-new day—even one small hello or helping hand can turn someone's whole day around!

episodes.title: The Crystal Cave Quest
episodes.subtitle: A Sparkling Adventure with Princess Crystal

beats.title: The Shimmering Cavern
beats.story: At the edge of the Frost Peak, you meet Princess Crystal! She is searching for a lost snowflake prism to light up the winter festival.

choices.label: Offer to help her search the cave!
choices.reactionText: Princess Crystal's eyes light up like ice diamonds! "Thank you! Two pairs of eyes are better than one."

choices.label: Stay outside and watch
choices.reactionText: Princess Crystal sighs softly and steps into the chilly cavern alone.

beats.title: The Glowing Prism
beats.story: Deep inside, a rainbow beam points to a high crystal shelf. Princess Crystal reaches up, but it's just out of reach!

choices.label: Hold her hand and boost her up!
choices.reactionText: Together you reach the snowflake prism! It fills the cave with dazzling rainbow light.

choices.label: Shrug and head back
choices.reactionText: Princess Crystal tries to jump for it on her own, looking disappointed.

welcoming.title: Sparkling New Friendship!
welcoming.story: Princess Crystal places the prism in the town square, and the whole kingdom cheers! She promises to visit your castle anytime.

exclusionary.title: A Chilly Afternoon
exclusionary.story: Princess Crystal eventually finds another way, though she wishes she had a friend by her side. Next time, lending a hand makes any quest warmer!

episodes.title: The Starlight Lantern Festival
episodes.subtitle: A Glowing Evening with Princess Aurora

beats.title: Lanterns by the Lake
beats.story: Twilight falls over the Royal Gardens! Princess Aurora is trying to untangle a string of starlight lanterns before the festival begins.

choices.label: Help untangle the lanterns!
choices.reactionText: Princess Aurora giggles! "With your help, these lanterns will shine brighter than ever!"

choices.label: Walk past to the snack table
choices.reactionText: Princess Aurora frowns as the ribbons tangle even more.

beats.title: Make a Wish
beats.story: The lanterns are ready to float into the night sky! Princess Aurora holds out a golden lantern for you.

choices.label: Launch the lanterns together!
choices.reactionText: The lanterns drift up into the stars, painting the sky in warm gold and violet!

choices.label: Decline and sit down
choices.reactionText: Princess Aurora releases her lantern quietly into the night.

welcoming.title: Starlight Friends Forever!
welcoming.story: You and Princess Aurora watch the sky glow with hundreds of wishes. She's thrilled to be your new royal pal!

exclusionary.title: A Quiet Festival
exclusionary.story: The lanterns still float up, but sharing a moment with a friend makes every celebration twice as magical.

episodes.title: The Coral Reef Treasure
episodes.subtitle: An Ocean Quest with Princess Coral

beats.title: By the Crystal Cove
beats.story: Down by the sparkling shore, Princess Coral is searching for a singing seashell that fell from her royal crown!

choices.label: Search the tidepools with her!
choices.reactionText: Princess Coral splashes happily! "You're the best treasure-hunting partner ever!"

choices.label: Say you're too busy
choices.reactionText: Princess Coral dips back into the waves with a worried look.

beats.title: The Singing Seashell
beats.story: You spot a shimmering pink shell tucked behind a starfish! A little crab is guarding it.

choices.label: Offer the crab a shiny pebble!
choices.reactionText: The crab happily trades! Princess Coral's seashell sings a joyful ocean melody.

choices.label: Leave it behind
choices.reactionText: Princess Coral swims away without her singing shell.

welcoming.title: Treasured Ocean Pal!
welcoming.story: Princess Coral places the singing shell back on her crown and invites you to join her on every royal adventure!

exclusionary.title: Drifting Waves
exclusionary.story: The tide rolls in quietly. Helping a friend find what they lost always brings the brightest smiles!

episodes.title: The Whispering Woods Picnic
episodes.subtitle: A Forest Gathering with Princess Willow

beats.title: The Mossy Meadow
beats.story: In the Whispering Woods, Princess Willow is setting up a tea picnic for the woodland bunnies, but a breeze blows her napkins away!

choices.label: Chase and catch the napkins!
choices.reactionText: Princess Willow claps her hands! "Thank you! You saved our woodland tea party!"

choices.label: Watch them float away
choices.reactionText: Princess Willow sighs as she tries to gather them alone.

beats.title: Berry Tarts & Tea
beats.story: The bunnies hop around the picnic blanket! Princess Willow pours a cup of honey-blossom tea for you.

choices.label: Share berry tarts with everyone!
choices.reactionText: Everyone cheers! Princess Willow says it's the coziest picnic in the kingdom.

choices.label: Eat quietly by yourself
choices.reactionText: The picnic feels a little quiet without sharing.

welcoming.title: Woodland Besties!
welcoming.story: Princess Willow crowns you with a daisy chain! She can't wait to explore the castle and gardens with you.

exclusionary.title: A Quiet Clearing
exclusionary.story: The woodland breeze whispers through the trees. Sharing kindness turns any afternoon into a celebration!
